title: Motion tween (basic)
description: Classic motion tween between two keyframes on a single instance: position, scale, rotation, alpha. Property inspector ease (−100…100). Exported as PlaceObject2 with ratio. Post-core-MVP animation slice. See docs/02-timeline-and-animation.md (Motion tween). Depends on timeline-mvp, symbols-library-mvp, swf-compiler-mvp.
